title: Wildly Savory Slovakian Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Slovakia, featuring a rich miso marinade and a hint of cream of tartar, all while being sugar-free-friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, cream of tartar, and 1 cup of chicken broth to create the marinade.
Add the pork cubes to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear the marinated pork until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the caraway seeds and paprika, cooking for 1 minute to allow the spices to bloom.
Add the remaining 3 cups of chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Stir in the sour cream and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until heated through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed, then serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
